claims: Croatia defeated Colombia 2-1 in an international friendly.
The international friendly took place on March 26, 2026.
The international friendly took place at Camping World Stadium in Orlando, Florida.
Jhon Arias scored for Colombia in the 2nd minute.
Luka Vuskovic scored for Croatia in the 6th minute.
Igor Matanovic scored for Croatia in the 42nd minute.
M. Pašalić provided an assist for Croatia in the 6th minute.
M. Pašalić provided an assist for Croatia in the 42nd minute.
Croatia and Colombia both utilized the friendly to prepare for the 2026 World Cup.
